title: Release 0.14.0 (quest half of the lore+quest pair; LCLI-705)
description: Quest half of the paired lore+quest v0.14.0 release (constitution Article 3). lore-cli ships LCLI-705 (Lore pane opening in teammate sessions); every release is a pair at one version, so quest ships 0.14.0 with the 55 commits on dev since 0.13.0. Follows docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md. Prep only until team-lead says otherwise: version bump PR to dev; merge, promotion, tag, staging, qualification and promotion to latest each come on the leader word, and npm publish and tag push are operator dialogs.

The CHANGELOG carries a dated ## 0.14.0 section and a fresh empty ## Unreleased above it at the tag
